about: Critic (C3, 2nd look): the owner's tail_seam (from V, the city warmed once a frame, then the cut into the seat) with frames after the cut and while pulling out, and a watch for the chapter's small card over the windscreen. FAILS today: 07_tail.js smallCard = !G.hud.cardT is false after V's own card (Hud.js leaves cardT at -1/60), so the card never shows. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/critic/tail_seam_frames.json --size 1440x900

steps.eval: (() => { const R = window.__seam = { warm: [], gaps: [], done: false, cut: null, after: [] }; let last = performance.now(); (function loop() { const now = performance.now(); R.gaps.push(+(now - last).toFixed(1)); last = now; if (!R.done) { const t0 = performance.now(); const ok = G.stages.warm('city', 6); R.warm.push(+(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(1)); if (ok) R.done = true; requestAnimationFrame(loop); } })(); return 1; })()

(() => { const R = window.__seam, info = N.renderer.info; R.prog = [info.programs.length]; R.p0 = new Set(info.programs); R.geo = [info.memory.geometries]; const t0 = performance.now(); G.scenes.go('tail', { beat: 'start', fade: 'cut', card: false }); R.cut = +(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(1); R.prog.push(info.programs.length); R.geo.push(info.memory.geometries); let last = performance.now(), n = 0; (function loop() { const now = performance.now(); R.after.push(+(now - last).toFixed(1)); last = now; if (n < 4) { R.prog.push(info.programs.length); R.geo.push(info.memory.geometries); } if (++n < 40) requestAnimationFrame(loop); })(); return R.cut; })()

(() => { window.__sawCard = null; const t0 = performance.now(); (function w() { const c = document.querySelector('.c3card'); if (c && c.style.display === 'block' && +c.style.opacity > 0.3) window.__sawCard = c.textContent.trim(); if (performance.now() - t0 < 9000) requestAnimationFrame(w); })(); return 1; })()
